title: Mirabel and the Songbook
author: August Vasquez
blurb: Silas Lockridge, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
